steps: Deployed the program to devnet (upgrade authority is the lab wallet)
issue_credential type campus-scout for the lab wallet as agent (credential 9QXpx6HL…)
Fetched credential: agent and issuer are the lab wallet, type=campus-scout, revoked=false
get_credential on the same account (still valid)
revoke_credential by the issuer; fetched revoked=true
evidence.functional_evidence: issue_credential wrote credential 9QXpx6HLdBZf2q6rYarS3ZPApgPfM8eSLj5kXzAH1zG1 for type campus-scout; get_credential succeeded while valid; revoke_credential set revoked=true; AlreadyRevoked rejected get and a second revoke; a 33-byte type was rejected as a PDA seed.
evidence.ui_check: The hosted page is the generic IDL console (connect Phantom or Solflare on devnet). It was not driven in headless Chromium in this run; the same issue, get and revoke instructions were sent with the lab wallet through the IDL client in tests/devnet/agenttrust.mjs.

limitations: The hosted IDL is hand-derived from source (anchor idl build failed in this toolchain) and was confirmed by the verifying transactions. UnauthorizedRevoke was not exercised (would need a second wallet).
